notes.title: Major Update: Deep Space Echoes
notes.content: [p]- Reworked level progression: Each stage is no longer a continuous large map node but now features various stations scattered across a planet, each with its own functional stronghold. The Imperial Army's pursuit forces are now displayed more clearly.[/p][p]Each stronghold may trigger special events, such as discovering rich mineral veins, electromagnetic interference, or vast open areas.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210878/8476329be5a500eb0a92f41f3e9089c6d0c43274.png"][/img][/p][p]- Overhauled the Modification Factory and Resistance Center functions[/p][p]Modification Factory: Can repair train durability, upgrade cards, and delete cards.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210878/91a943f3f1dc0786e61df9dce3e445ccf12efcf4.png"][/img][/p][p]Resistance Center: Can purchase exclusive train upgrades.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210878/55627f73ce65a561f62cfc9593832e8446e53141.png"][/img][/p][p]- Blueprint adjustments: Train modifications can now be adjusted directly from the train info panel.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210878/4b5fcd6366aa7a46a96ba02d16b6edccff6e6977.png"][/img][/p][p]- Reworked most mercenary effects.[/p][p]- Overhauled equipment cards, now functioning as permanent weapon upgrades.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210878/9a6c832b1370cd4d4f8bbf7c093b9c0225710c39.png"][/img] [/p][p]- Reworked the unlock method for train-exclusive cards.[/p][p]- Adjusted balance for most cards.[/p][p]- Revised train storage rules: Exceeding capacity now requires discarding items to proceed.[/p][p]- Core system adjustments: Once unlocked, cores can be freely selected in the base scene. Core usage no longer consumes energy, only requiring cooldown.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210878/53182f10c3d12608c71fd2d7bbcb8f388343d944.png"][/img][/p][p]- Exploration system rework: Now divided into four dimensions—exploration item quantity, carry capacity, danger level, and max dispatch count. Each dimension has a cap, and assigning crew affects these values without exceeding limits.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210878/eaf67c3a6c36ed3e39978d1ef3e310620ee62011.png"][/img][/p][p]- Reworked train selection screen, adding the Iron Fearless β model.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210878/6b9e9099a7347b310dd541696e4b79af88fe9930.png"][/img][/p][p]- Frontline stronghold rework: Now grants starting buffs by spending Honor Points, which increase with game difficulty.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210878/f430c844183d88f1c26ca94d3a21af82f46802dc.png"][/img][/p][p]- Train upgrade adjustments: Upgrades can now be performed anytime via the info panel, no longer requiring facility visits. Upgrades are obtainable from the Resistance Center and Research Lab.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210878/4697ff9504ca70baca7880ff4bfa5348c4dbcdd5.png"][/img][/p][p]- New peripheral strongholds:[/p][p]Forge: Can upgrade 1 weapon for free.[/p][p]Research Lab: Can upgrade 1 train enhancement for free.[/p]

notes.title: Break Siege Now Available in Early Access with Steam Deck Support!
notes.content:
Greetings, Commanders!

Today marks the official launch of Break Siege!

This is a train-themed real-time roguelike deck-building game! Just like the name suggests, you’ll be constantly building your own deck as you fight your way through the relentless forces of the Imperial in intense, fast-paced battles. We hope you enjoy the thrill and excitement this game has to offer!

The game now supports Steam Deck, and Mac support will be included in future optimization updates.
If you encounter any issues during gameplay, please feel free to join our official Discord group (https://discord.gg/mzxbyr4seY) and provide feedback. We’ll continue to refine and improve the game based on your suggestions.

Of course, we also welcome everyone to share the play experiences and insights with us in any time!
Lastly, if you enjoy Break Siege, we’d be incredibly grateful if you could leave a review on our Steam page and recommend it to your friends.

Your support and encouragement mean the world to us—thank you for being part of this journey!

notes.title: Get Ready for Break Siege at Steam's Eastern Game Fest!
notes.content:
Attention, Commanders!
Our real-time roguelike deck-building game [Break Siege] will be participating in the Eastern Game Fest Sale 2025 from 10:00 AM (PT), April 23 to 10:00 AM (PT), May 2, 2025!
And that’s not all—the game will officially launch globally on Steam at 11:00 PM (PT), May 7, 2025! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210878/24d2d4fbc50cd9e873a609f2b089c209481e316b.jpg[/img]

In Break Siege, you’ll constantly construct your own deck, breakthrough the imperial forces in intense, real-time battles.
To carry out the resistance’s critical mission, you must take control of an interstellar train capable of traveling between planets, outmaneuver the imperial pursuit, and fulfill your destiny.
If you like what you see, don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist and join the official Discord group: https://discord.gg/mzxbyr4seY to share your feedback and connect with fellow players!

notes.title: SteamNextFest！
notes.content:
Greetings, dear frineds!
Our game "Break Siege" is now featured in Steam Next Fest, and we're actively gathering your real-time feedback. Now, let me introduce the elite enemies you'll encounter in the demo version.  
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/pHaphwxyEj 

[b]Hyena Eagle[/b]
As Imperial elite troops, they employ wolf pack tactics to encircle targets. During combat, they continuously summon Hyena Eagle followers for support while unleashing rapid-fire missiles that penetrate shields.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210878/823519f5eebb2a3cc1c02114a4cc2bdb94315a83.gif[/img]
[b]TT Eagle[/b]
Equipped with two strategic jamming devices – "Iron Tooth and Copper Tooth" – this foe requires you to disable both devices to neutralize its threat.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210878/051883cc6ffc16c2da8dd8c0019de11f4cbec58f.gif[/img]
[b]Fog Eagle[/b]
Dubbed "Sky Scarecrow" by the Imperial elite troops, this unit coordinates drone swarms despite having no offensive capabilities itself. Its assault drones (C. torquatus) initiate suicide charges when ammunition depletes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210878/644e559514d1bf359ffbe6109cb2cc26112e43ca.gif[/img]
Meanwhile, disruption drones (P. torquatus) gradually overwhelm players with intense electromagnetic interference.  
These are the elites you'll encounter in the Next Fest demo - each demands your full attention. Beyond them, you'll also face diverse minions with specialized attacks and the overwhelming presence of boss-class aircraft carriers.  

Finally, stay tuned for the latest updates and remember to share your gaming experience directly with developers in our community!

notes.title: Demo Update And Welcome Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
Hello everyone! To welcome Steam Next Fest, we've prepared a plethora of content updates for the demo! Let's check it out.

Modification Factory
In the game, players can obtain a new type of card called "Carriage Blueprints" through various means. These cards do not occupy deck slots and do not affect the combat process. However, they can be used in the modification factory to upgrade carriages, thereby enhancing the train's combat effectiveness.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210878/0e0994cd63965ef3b735bb9f88dea867691ecf23.jpg[/img]

Gear Combination
Each "Carriage Blueprint" has two gear attributes. The higher the level of the same gear stacked, the stronger the effect you can obtain. The modification of carriages is full of strategy. Moreover, every time you acquire a "Carriage Blueprint," the gears are randomly generated, ensuring that each adventure is filled with surprises and fun.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210878/09b59004fff85f8ee018acec2d0c30a7dd72bff6.jpg[/img]

Train Enhancement
Each time you enter Modification Factory, five train enhancement options are available. Players can use resources to strengthen the train as needed to deal with a variety of enemies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210878/0ac6917afd32c3829418c9ffb8e5a18e053f330c.jpg[/img]

Peripheral Stronghold
The Peripheral Stronghold is the focus of this update. Now, a varying number of peripheral strongholds will be generated around each major stronghold. Each peripheral stronghold has different functions, which makes the route selection no longer singular.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210878/57316abfa79a359b0da66e2f1c50b219feab760b.jpg[/img]
Here are some of the peripheral strongholds:
Transit Station - A place where mercenaries gather.
Transfer Warehouse - Where you can accept cargo escort missions.
Repair Workshop - Where you can use resources to repair the train's durability.
Forge - Where you can use resources to enhance cards.
Dismantling Yard - Where you can use resources to remove 1 card.
Recycling Station - Where you can sell various goods.
Biomass Recovery Bay - Where you can treat injured mercenaries, which requires time.

Enemies
This demo added two new elite enemies and one new boss enemy.


Join the official game community to share your thoughts and don't forget to add the game to your wishlist on the Steam store page either~ It's very important to us. Thank you again for your support!
https://discord.gg/pHaphwxyEj
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210878/cfcc904342d1ce2cf1228eb26a3c0cbc5197a2cf.png[/img]

notes.title: The Break Siege Wishing Everyone Happy New Year!
notes.content:
Holle，

Wishing Everyone Happy New Year!

On this happy day, we also bring you the latest information about the game.
Now the game in the stronghold surrounding will generate a variety of peripheral stronghold, each peripheral stronghold has a different effect and revenue, players to the choice of route to add a lot of considerations, let me introduce some of the stronghold.
[h3]1.Exploration Point[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210878/aa7b10b6ef094ee4424a2d9691d952328f6eda47.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210878/89ecb1b824659601388c835ee929f4991bf34a77.jpg[/img]
The exploration point can send mercenaries to explore, explore the completion of the search will find a variety of things, but each exploration needs to consume time, but too much time will be consumed by the Imperial army pursuit forces to catch up with a fierce battle, so the balance of benefits and risks.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210878/b22010bc2a99a7b8da36e70e38489bd72e0d130c.jpg[/img]

[h3]2.Recovery point[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210878/da73b559a7dae8b5daf5182f494e357a9c0fa744.jpg[/img]
The goods found at the discovery point can be sold through the recovery point, but it should be noted that the price of the goods is different at each recovery point, so it is necessary to sell according to the timing to maximize profits, but if the car stockpiled too much goods will cause the train speed to slow down, increasing the risk of being caught by the Imperial army pursuers.

[h3]3.Treatment bunker[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210878/caaa8b293ae1bc009b3e0fdb467aca05ab62fc8c.jpg[/img]
Mercenaries will inevitably be injured during the journey, affecting the efficiency of dispatch exploration, then you need to repair the warehouse for mercenary treatment.


[h3]4.Transfer station[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210878/90cbbc40f5e43a9ca043a99a218046f7d5c165b6.jpg[/img]
There are all kinds of people at the transit station waiting to get on the departing train and get paid just to get on it, but there are all kinds of circumstances behind them, so the journey is no longer normal.


[h3]5.Transfer bin[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210878/79ede81d9a24bbf31a5acb3657b0c0b83c005c1e.jpg[/img]
There are many warehouses around the base, which have a lot of goods that need to be transported to other planets and bases every day, so there are often escort tasks distributed.

Peripheral stronghold first introduced here, see so many various stronghold is not feel the adventure journey is no longer monotonous, later we will update more stronghold gameplay, please look forward to.
Finally, we have an important system to introduce, that is, the train reinforcement system.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210878/e0c37e8352e495234f894afcde9cd469082caf9a.jpg[/img]
At present, the maintenance factory can provide the modification service of the train, and the modification project is also exclusive to each train, and each station will provide two inherent modifications and three special modifications randomly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210878/84e995119463058f4201d8ee3af5fdb93ed9d579.jpg[/img]
In addition to the conversion service, the maintenance factory also provides replacement services for the carriages, but the replacement requires drawings, which can be obtained by road. In addition to the basic capabilities provided by each car drawing, there is also a combination of gear additions, so that the modification of the car is also full of decisions.

Well, that's enough information for today! Thank you all for your support.
Wish all players the best in the New Year!

Also don't forget to add your game to the wishlist on the steam Store page - this is very important to us, thanks again for your support!
